tracker.confidencePolicy: Keep tracker confidence in quality metadata; do not use continuous confidence as a recognition feature.

coordinates.metricRule: Before distances or normalization, map normalized x to x*imageWidth, y to y*imageHeight, and MediaPipe z to z*imageWidth. This removes portrait-versus-landscape x/y distortion.
coordinates.mirrorPolicy: Apply one explicit source adapter before canonical dominance. PopSign uses keep.
coordinates.depthPolicy: Keep local hand z. Center visible shoulder-normalized wrist z on its active-interval median.

dominanceNormalization.selection: The detected hand present in the most active-interval frames is dominant; ties keep the right hand as dominant.
dominanceNormalization.leftDominantRule: Reflect x coordinates, exchange paired upper-body anchors, and place the detected left hand in the dominant slot.

shapeNormalization.scale: mean aspect-corrected 2D distance from wrist to index MCP, middle MCP, and pinky MCP
shapeNormalization.rotation: none; preserve palm and finger orientation

normalization.headOffset: Each visible hand wrist also stores x/y offset from the visible nose, divided by shoulder width.
normalization.missingRule: Coordinates are zero only with present zero.

sequence.raw: Retain increasing timestamps and every stable detailed hand result before normalization.

activeInterval.rule: Bridge at most three missing dominant-hand frames, prefer the densest sustained run, and retain two context frames.
activeInterval.browserRule: A hands-free countdown begins capture after readiness.

sequence.resampling: Nearest observed source frame by timestamp across the active interval.
sequence.missingValues: Use zero coordinates only with explicit zero presence.
sequence.frameFeatureLayout: dominant hand 69, non-dominant hand 69, then 11 upper-body anchors x 3

requirements.bodyChannels: Nose and shoulders are required for head-relative and body-relative location during scans.
requirements.faceExpressionChannels: Not included; the nose is a positional head reference, not facial-expression recognition.
requirements.deviceModes: Reduced pose cadence may reuse the latest anchors but never reduces hand landmark count.
